title: OR-Path Domain Collaboration Contract — Meta-Schema
description: Formalizes the structure any OR-Path domain collaboration contract (e.g. contracts/tube_collaboration_v1.json) must satisfy: stable schema id, numeric authority, lexicographic selection order, role ownership/forbidden boundaries, budget split, candidate lifecycle, and stop rules.

schema.description: Stable contract id of the form orpath.<domain>_collaboration.v<N>.

problem_id.description: OR-Path problem identifier this collaboration contract governs.

numeric_authority.description: Who owns objective numbers; must be local solvers + independent validator, never agent vote.

selection_rule.description: Rule for comparing and selecting candidates (e.g. lexicographic_not_agent_vote). Optional but typed.

budget_scope.description: What the percentage budget applies to.

budget_percent.description: Discretionary effort split per workstream, in whole percent.

roles.description: Role boundary map: each role owns artifacts and is forbidden from others.

candidate_lifecycle.description: Ordered candidate states from PROPOSED to ACCEPTED.

forbidden.description: Actions this role is forbidden from performing.
